items.title: Multi-tenant Portal + Open API
items.summary: 0→1 institutional portal with account, permission, subscription, and payment APIs; permission-driven UI; unified auth and enterprise quotas; desktop internal tooling.
highlights: Portal + Open API delivery across multiple product lines
Split commercial write paths from market-data read paths; hot-path Redis caching
Short-lived task tokens for remote GPU evaluation workflows; shared auth & error codes across clients

items.title: SaaS Frontend Platform
items.summary: Owned architecture and delivery for a multi-end SaaS surface: NestJS BFF, micro-frontends, component library → configuration, document pipelines, and SSR / private deployment.
highlights: Project bootstrap reduced from days to hours
High-frequency pages moved to configuration to cut duplicate work
BFF + SSR / private-deploy path landed in production

items.title: CMS Micro-frontend Split
items.summary: CMS iteration with monolith → Qiankun split, shared component library, and H5 low-code delivery.
highlights: Apps ship independently after the split

items.title: Data Viz & Engineering Standards

highlights: Unified project standards and scaffolding across teams
Lower collaboration cost through shared tooling
